units: <cite ref="Sukkah 33b:13">Succ. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>כא׳ של וכ׳</he> as a bunch of herbs is tied; a. fr.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 88">Gen. R. s. 88</cite> <he>א׳ אחת</he> one brotherhood.—Pl. <he>אֲגוּדּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:2">Makhsh. VI, 2</cite> <he>א׳ של בית וכ׳</he> (herb) bunches which have been lying in the market houses; v.
<cite ref="Yevamot 13b:17">Yeb. 13ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>תתגדדו</he> <cite ref="Deuteronomy 14:1">Deut. XIV, 1</cite>) <he>לא תעשו א׳ א׳</he> do not form yourselves into religious factions.

senses.gloss: בֵּית א׳ pr. n. of a family, Beth-Aguddah. Mass. Sof’rim IV, 1 של ב׳ א׳ … the scribes of the family Beth-Ag.
